ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution corresponding to localized scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white annular and circular motifs mapped across both lobes, with a higher concentration along the lower medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 120 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with variable amplitudes; notable macro-indentations present on the medial-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves sweeping laterally from the notch, transitioning to a sharp upward-concave curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed spatial distribution of white circular and C-shaped pixel clusters (rosettes) ranging from 10 to 40 pixels in diameter across the entire visible ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-section of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcified barnacle clusters present on the apical tips of both lobes; secondary deep notches/tears located on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity textured clusters (barnacles) creating a jagged, non-fleshy appearance at the extreme lateral-top boundaries of the fluke lobes.
